topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Hey, I heard you're thinking about using a bit of my yard for a garden. That's sweet of you to ask. I'll be honest, I’ve been spending a lot of time just staring at that space, trying to think of what to do with it. It’s been a while since I've really done anything there. I guess, if you really want to, you can go ahead. Just make sure to plant some of those sunflowers you love; they always seem to brighten things up. I hope it helps you feel closer to the earth, like you’ve always wanted. Let me know if you need any help with the soil or anything.
